headline: National Museum of Ecuador recalls Alberto Campo Baeza design after public backlash
context: A winning design for a new National Museum of Ecuador building in Quito by Spanish outfit Studio Alberto Campo Baeza and local studio MAODA has been called back by the government, with the studios claiming the move "breaks the transparency and integrity of a public competition".

sources.name: Dezeen
